REQ-001.scenario: Retrieve the list of synthetic samples
REQ-001.expectedOutcome: The API returns synthetic samples with valid identifiers and expected fields.

REQ-002.expectedOutcome: Fragment lengths of 0 and 100001 are rejected; boundary values 1 and 100000 are accepted when other fields are valid.

REQ-003.scenario: Validate quality classification at the threshold
REQ-003.expectedOutcome: Signal quality 0.79 is REVIEW and 0.80 is PASS.

REQ-004.expectedOutcome: Each successful analysis creates an audit event with a sample ID, action, result, and timestamp, without patient identifiers.

REQ-005.scenario: Verify API responses do not expose patient PII
REQ-005.expectedOutcome: Synthetic sample and audit API responses contain no patient names, birth dates, or patient identifiers.
